authority_rule: Official source currency and technical relevance do not establish InterSol legal/project applicability or compliance.
current_source_notes: Queensland project NCC edition/application depends on approval timing, classification and transition provisions.
AS 2982:2026 and AS 4775:2026 are current source records for laboratory design and emergency wash respectively, but actual application remains process/hazard dependent.
AS/NZS 1680.1 is retained as a candidate Australian workplace-lighting source and is listed pending revision; recheck before design freeze.
CIE integrative/workplace/obtrusive-light documents are design/research references unless separately adopted into the project basis.
ISO 16813:2024 is used as an integrated-design methodology reference, not an Australian compliance claim.
NCCIH evidence is used only to enforce a research/claim boundary around biofield-labelled work.
